title: Policy Extrapolation Precision in Randomized Network Blocks with Bounded Interaction Spectrum
banked_reason: D-0.5 terminal:proposal-no-pass: both bounded author attempts returned needs-pivot with no proto_core; mandatory critical q=3/4,m=ceil(exp(d/5)) slice lacks a matched legal analytic all-record risk theorem. Construction/authorability stop only, not conjecture refutation or proven nonnovelty.
gap_reasons: The mandatory critical-slice kill test did not close. At q=3/4 and m=ceil(exp(d/5)), the audited truncated-transport upper bound and a legal analytic product-direction lower bound have different exponential rates; no matching polynomial correction was obtained. The uniform frontier therefore cannot pass the stated launch gate, and no typed core was written. Presolve accounting: (1) Retained the sanity witness after checking its cube values, target and ellipsoid energy. (2) Retained the smooth-baseline prior and original-record testing architecture after auditing table legality, translation control, tensorization and auxiliary randomization; these remain supporting ingredients. (3) Retained the direct nonsymmetric-record upper-bound architecture and polar duality; explicit uniformly optimal weights remain deferred. (4) Retained deterministic symmetrization, odd cancellation and Krawtchouk normalization; rejected replacing arbitrary observed-outcome laws by symmetric-table laws. (5) Retained exact zero at half saturation and the full-rollout evaluation as boundary checks. (6) Retained the one-block, one-coordinate and near-half evaluations after analytical checks. (7) Retained the inactive-cube criterion and its sufficient large-block-count region; complete order-change boundaries remain deferred. (8) Retained the critical-slice separation from the capped spectral expression after checking the truncation and exponent arithmetic; it supplies an upper-bound separation, not the required matched risk. (9) Retained the bounded-only scalar-root modulus; intersection equivalence and controlled analytic extension remain deferred. Exact rational checks reject norm-preserving pointwise clipping as a shortcut. (10) Retained finite-dimensional attainment and KKT machinery as generic support; positivity is rejected by an explicit legal small-dimensional direction, while single-contact structure remains unresolved. (11) Retained numerical receipts only as diagnostics; floating contacts, coefficients and ratios are not universal certificates. (12) Deferred certified uniform evaluation, tolerance guarantees, attaining-weight recovery and final computational cost. (13) Retained the prospective rollout consumer with no empirical validation claim; excluded the burned general-support finite-game kernel. These supporting reductions do not satisfy the explicit uniform-rate contract.

Invoked the escalation's early-kill rule after attempting the directed critical slice. The bounded-only Switch benchmark was evaluated analytically, including its count threshold, logarithmic correction, exponential rate and polynomial factor. A direct clipped-likelihood witness violates the analytic ellipsoid: along odd block sizes its highest Walsh degree alone has exponentially growing weighted energy. Exact rational checks corroborated the coefficient identity. This rejects that witness, not alternative (A). Neither a legal analytic witness matching the benchmark nor alternative (B)'s matched replacement rate was obtained. No proposal core was written. Presolve accounting: (1) Retained the sanity table after exact verification of its cube values, ellipsoid normalization and policy contrast. (2) Retained smooth-baseline legality, translation control, product Hellinger testing and auxiliary-randomization handling as audited supporting arguments; the priors randomize fixed schedules and preserve complete labeled records. (3) Retained direct nonsymmetric-record bias/variance bounds and polar duality as supporting reductions; their unevaluated modulus does not meet the kernel. (4) Retained permutation averaging, oddification and Krawtchouk normalization as deterministic contractions; rejected replacement of arbitrary observation laws by symmetric-table laws. (5) Retained ridge transport, the inactive-cube criterion, and its sufficient large-block-count region after checking the coefficient normalization; deferred complete order-change boundaries. (6) Retained the half-saturation zero rule, full-rollout calculation, one-block and one-coordinate evaluations, and sine-based near-half bounds as audited boundary arguments; these do not settle the directed slice. (7) Retained the critical-slice truncation upper bound and capped-spectral separation after checking tilting and exponent arithmetic; rejected treating either as a matched minimax rate. (8) Retained scalar-root bounded-only optimization as a benchmark; deferred analytic-extension equivalence, positivity, single-contact structure and legal attaining weight recovery. (9) Retained numerical receipts only as diagnostics; rejected floating optima, contacts and finite-grid ratios as universal certificates. Certified computation remains deferred. (10) Retained source ingredients from [Loomba–Eckles](https://arxiv.org/html/2609.02756v1), [Ma–Zhu–Jiao–Wainwright](https://arxiv.org/html/2101.07781v1), [Mou–Ding–Wainwright–Bartlett](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.06240v1), [Wang–Agarwal–Dudik](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v70/wang17a/wang17a.pdf) and [Li–Munos–Szepesvari](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v38/li15b.pdf); none inspected supplies the missing bounded analytic witness. The burned general-support finite-game kernel remains excluded. (11) Deferred empirical class validation and rejected claims of demonstrated platform gains. All retained presolve mathematics remains unverified prior work, not established results. The original-record all-estimator matched slice and its novelty floor remain unresolved.
proof_attempt_summary: Both proposal authors returned needs-pivot without a typed core. The full uniform frontier retained unmatched critical-slice exponential bounds; the narrower repair evaluated the bounded-only Switch benchmark but its clipped-likelihood witness violated the analytic ellipsoid. This is a bounded construction/authorability stop, not a refutation or proven nonnovelty: a new legal matched critical-slice construction is required before reraising. No D0, F-stage or Lean module was produced.
